meta.name: github-deep-research
meta.description: Conduct multi-round deep research on any GitHub Repo. Use when users request comprehensive analysis, timeline reconstruction, competitive analysis, or in-depth investigation of GitHub. Produces structured markdown reports with executive summaries, chronological timelines, metrics analysis, and Mermaid diagrams. Triggers on Github repository URL or open source projects.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剖析任意 GitHub 仓库,输出带时间线与指标的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想快速摸清一个开源项目的健康状况与演进历史。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze any GitHub repo and output report with timeline and metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly understand a repository's health and history.

howto.what: 对任意 GitHub 仓库做多轮深度调研,先查 GitHub API,再用网络搜索和抓取补充信息,最后输出一份带执行摘要、时间线、指标对比和 Mermaid 图表的 Markdown 报告,并附引用来源。
howto.when: 当用户给出 GitHub 仓库链接或点名某个开源项目,并要求做深入调查、重建时间线、竞争分析等研究时触发。

say.text: 帮我深度调研这个 GitHub 仓库,输出完整报告
分析这个项目的开发时间线和重要事件
say.note: 会重建时间线并用 Mermaid 甘特图展示。

say.text: 对比这个仓库和它的主要竞品
say.note: 会做指标对比和优劣势分析。

howto.what_en: Performs multi-round deep research on any GitHub repo, using the GitHub API first, then web_search and web_fetch to fill gaps. Outputs a structured Markdown report with executive summary, timeline, metrics analysis, Mermaid diagrams, and inline citations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a GitHub repository URL or an open-source project is provided, or when users ask for deep analysis, timeline reconstruction, or competitive research on a GitHub repo.

say_en.text: Research this GitHub repository and give me a full report.
say_en.note: Claude starts multi-round deep research and produces a Markdown report.

say_en.text: Analyze the project's development timeline and key events.
say_en.note: It rebuilds the timeline and shows a Mermaid Gantt chart.

say_en.text: Compare this repository with its main competitors.
say_en.note: It provides metrics comparison and strengths/weaknesses.
